method_requirements: Use the locked event-window dates from the anchor record.
Use ERA5-Land aggregate temperature, precipitation, and wind statistics.
Use GPM and CHIRPS event precipitation summaries for the low-precipitation tail and consensus terms.
Do not replace package values with outside point-weather series.

primary_gt.brief_method: Use the locked window, ERA5 gridded heat score, ERA5/GPM/CHIRPS low-precipitation tail score, ERA5 wind-vector ventilation score, and 2-decimal aggregate index rounding.

criteria.description: Uses the locked 2021-03-26 to 2021-04-10 date span and reports 16 event-window days.
criteria.name: Event-window reconstruction
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points for the right date span with one off-by-one day-count or endpoint error.

criteria.description: Reports ERA5 max, mean, and minimum Tmax values and heat_score 3.
criteria.name: Gridded heat block
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-3 points for mostly correct temperature values with one threshold or rounding mistake.

criteria.description: Reports ERA5, GPM, CHIRPS, consensus precipitation means, all three low-tail flags, and low_precip_tail_score 3.
criteria.name: Precipitation block
criteria.partial_credit: Award up to 3 points for correct subsets of the precipitation means, flags, and score.

criteria.description: Computes mean wind speed, maximum wind-vector screen, mean ventilation deficit, and ventilation_score 2.
criteria.name: Wind ventilation block
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-3 points for mostly correct vector calculations with one threshold or rounding mistake.

criteria.description: Computes aggregate_persistence_index 13.00 and all four threshold flags as true.
criteria.name: Index and flags
criteria.partial_credit: Award 2-3 points for the right direction with one arithmetic or flag error.

criteria.description: Includes the requested answer label and brief method note without replacing the numeric ledger with prose.
criteria.name: Method and concise output
criteria.partial_credit: Award 0.5 point for a correct label or method note when the other is missing or too vague.

scope_limits: Do not treat the index as an observed PM2.5, AQI, or smoke concentration measurement.
Do not infer smoke origin, transport direction, health outcomes, closures, or universal forecast thresholds.
